name: Welcome to Ponyville
summary: “Welcome to Ponyville” is a story based adventure (visual novel) game. Taking place directly after Season 2, the game features a multitude of jobs to perform, a furnishable home, two main intertwining storylines, a plethora of sub-stories, and over 50 characters to interact with. You, the player, will often get to make decisions that directly influence not only the characters within the game, but even Equestria as a whole. Utilizing a custom built engine, “Welcome to Ponyville” should never be the same game twice. So, what are you waiting for? Grab your luggage, head to the train station, and hop on the first available train to Ponyville; a magical world filled with candy colored ponies, friendship, romance, and adventure. After all, nothing dark or scary ever happens in Ponyville... Right?
